name: How should I prepare my room before drywall texture repair starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my room before drywall texture repair starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your contractor arrives, clear personal belongings, furniture, and wall hangings at least several feet away from the work area. Let the contractor know in advance if the damage was caused by plumbing leaks or roof intrusion so they can verify underlying wood framing is dry. Securing pets and designating a clear pathway from the entryway protects your home, as drywall work involves dust, masking plastic, and texturing gear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from the wall, remove nearby wall hangings, keep pets in another room, and confirm that any previous water sources have been fully dried out.
